name: TC-04-meter-reading
description: TC-04.3: Meter & Meter Reading — Navigate to meter entities and create readings

doc_metadata.title: TC-04.3 — Meter List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Meter. Meters track operating parameters like running hours, odometer readings, and cycle counts for assets.

doc_metadata.title: TC-04.3 — Meter Overview
doc_metadata.caption: The meter list shows all configured meters across assets with their current readings, types, and update frequency.

doc_metadata.title: TC-04.3 — New Meter
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to create a meter. Specify the meter type (Operating Hours, Odometer, Cycle Count), linked asset, and unit of measure.

steps.target: input[name='meter_name'], textarea[name='meter_name'], input[name='name'], textarea[name='name'], input[name='description'], textarea[name='description']

doc_metadata.title: TC-04.3 — Fill Meter Name
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Operating Hours Meter" into the Meter Name field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-04.3 — Meter Created
doc_metadata.caption: The meter is created and linked to an asset. Add meter readings to track operating parameters over time.

doc_metadata.title: TC-04.3 — Meter Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The meter detail page shows the meter type, current reading, and reading history. Meter readings trigger preventive maintenance based on configured thresholds.

doc_metadata.title: TC-04.3 — Meter Reading List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Meter Reading. Meter readings record periodic measurements for meters linked to assets.

doc_metadata.title: TC-04.3 — New Meter Reading
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to record a new meter reading. Select the meter, enter the reading value, and timestamp.

doc_metadata.title: TC-04.3 — Meter Reading Form
doc_metadata.caption: The meter reading form captures the current value, date, and any notes. The system calculates the delta from the previous reading automatically.
